text_block_list.text:
Today is <chrname>'s day off from training,
and as I was wondering how to spend the day—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: To improve stamina, the key is how to increase lung capacity—hmm?
choice_data_list: Are you heading to training now?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer <username>.
I'm just about to start training Little Cocon.
Trainer Kashimoto is in charge of another Umamusume named Little Cocon, besides Bitter Glace.
She pushed through and won her debut race; she's quite a formidable competitor.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
From here on—well, knowing her,
she's probably already started training by now.
Since it was a great opportunity, I accompanied Trainer Kashimoto to observe Little Cocon's training.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're Little Cocon, right?!
Your debut race was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I totally get it! Hey, wanna train alongside us?
Come run with us!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...I'll pass.
I don't really like matching paces with someone else.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, rejected!
Oh well, hang out with me when you feel like it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, if I feel like it.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Good work, Little Cocon.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto.
I look forward to working with you today as well.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...And who do we have over there?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I am Trainer <username>.
I'd like to observe your training today.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Observing? Hmph...
Not sure what you think you're gonna learn, though.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's get started right away.
First, five laps around the dirt track at a three-minute pace.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...There is a weapon
I'd like her to polish."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Stamina—it is a weapon that will allow you to unleash a long, sustained spurt even as race distances increase.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Since I run long distances, I want to avoid putting too much strain on my legs, so I incorporate more dirt tracks into my training.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: Yo, my little lambs!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Darley Arabian-san,
is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. She's got some pretty sharp instincts.
Little Cocon's weapon... it really is remarkable!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
"In her case, because her fundamental abilities are so high,
at first glance one tends to focus primarily on speed."

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: "Still, what's truly powerful are the heart and lungs! We gotta polish those weapons to the absolute limit!"

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, just to check, Little Cocon is pretty stoic about everything, right?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she even puts in steady running on her own
before our training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
I knew it. I was wondering why it ended up like that
even though Trainer Kashimoto was managing it,
but now it makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon,
your balance is slightly off.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Balance...?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
In her case, because she's so stoic,
she was doing a bit too much running.
Conversely, her awareness of her upper body had weakened.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Then how about we use that time
to do some full-body workouts?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Or you could try increasing your caloric intake.
It'd be better to put a bit more weight on your upper body.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: Even a minor mistake in training can ruin an athlete's stamina or burst of speed, after all.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I eagerly had her do it thinking it would double as a warm-up, but to think it was subtly throwing off her balance...

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Each and every Umamusume shines in her own unique way.
Cherish her individuality!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That girl's got some great flair too!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...I suppose that knowledge was also extracted
as the most appropriate choice from vast amounts of data."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... However, a Trainer must be
the one person their Umamusume can rely on most."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Based on this advice, I must ensure
that Little Cocon grows properly.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: “—As long as you train your entire body without placing undue strain on it in this manner, there shouldn't be any issue.”

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
...Um, thank you so much for looking over
my independent training as well.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
No, I should have paid closer attention as well,
instead of just getting carried away by your positive attitude.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However, thanks to that, it has become much clearer to me.
How you will run from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Let us polish your weapon.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: "And so, I have just finalized your rotation, so allow me to walk you through it."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
First, gain plenty of ring experience,
building up race experience and conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
And next year, we'll take on the grand stage.
Especially races where your strengths can truly shine.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Next year's... big stage...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Let's go together to the Classic races.

Trainer Kashimoto and Little Cocon, polishing individuality hand in hand.
And Darley Arabian, who cherishes individuality.

Watching the three interact, it felt as though individuality
itself was the very definition of an Umamusume.
